name: Cosmetic Treatments
intro: Considered for restoring lost volume and softening lines from facial movement, following a full clinical assessment.
imageAlt: Treatment handpiece above the brow, close-up
statement: Considered for *restoring volume* and *softening lines from facial movement,* following assessment.
suits: Patients seeking to address specific areas of volume or movement, following a full facial assessment.
notSuitable: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, active skin infection in the treatment area, or certain allergies.
assessed: Facial structure, movement patterns and medical history are reviewed before any treatment is recommended.
before: Skin is cleansed and, if needed, a topical numbing cream applied.
during: Treatment is administered by your practitioner following assessment of the area.
after: Mild swelling, redness or bruising is possible for a few days.
risks: Risks may include bruising, swelling, asymmetry or, rarely, more significant complications; discussed in full at consultation.
